title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
title_zh: NEXUS：用于地形自适应遥操作感知全身控制
abstract: Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method. Project website: https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/
abstract_zh: 全身遥操作要求人形机器人即使在与操作者地形不同的情况下也能复现人类操作者的行为。这要求机器人感知局部地形并相应地调整其姿态和接触，而不是逐帧复制操作者的运动。然而，将相同行为在平地与不同地形间关联的配对运动数据仍然稀缺，限制了对学习地形自适应控制的监督。为了实现跨不匹配地形的全身遥操作，我们提出了NEXUS，一个感知全身控制框架，将人体运动命令与机载感官反馈相结合。我们首先开发了一种可扩展的地形感知自适应算法，能够高效生成跨运动与地形的高质量运动对，而无需针对每个运动或地形进行调参。利用总计近1,000小时的配对运动语料库，我们通过教师-学生学习训练了一个感知全身控制器，以在不同地形上复现命令行为。实验证明了高质量运动数据的高效、可扩展生成，并表明NEXUS结合了广泛的行为覆盖与地形适应性和跟踪保真度，在评估基准上优于现有的全身控制器。零样本真实世界部署实现了在多样未见地形上的实时全身遥操作，进一步验证了我们方法的泛化能力。项目网站：https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/
tldr_zh: NEXUS框架实现跨地形全身遥操作，通过感知地形自适应控制。
cover_zh: 地形不同也能同步？NEXUS让遥操作机器人自己适应地形！
